newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Six miners killed in explosion at Russian pit.
newsitem.headline: Six miners killed in explosion at Russian pit.

text.p: Six miners were killed on Friday in an explosion at a coalmine near Magadan in Russia's far east, the emergencies ministry said.
A ministry spokeswoman said by telephone that the cause of the blast at the Kadykchan pit in the Magadan region was not known, but one possibility being considered was that methane gas had ignited.
The six dead miners had been brought to the surface after the explosion at 3.25 a.m. Moscow time (0025 GMT).
"We do not expect the death toll to rise. We have no reports that anyone else was hurt in the explosion," the spokeswoman said.
